BiblicalUsage: mamrôr is bitterness, and it occurs once, in Job 9:18. Job says God will not suffer him to take his breath, but fills him with bitterness. The word is the taste of a life that cannot catch its breath.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe mamrôr tells the truth about suffering, that bitterness is real and God hears the man who names it.
